items.office: Comisionado de Transparencia y Acceso a la Información Pública
items.purpose_en: On 23 November 2026 a submission was registered in the R865/2026 access matter after the further ten-working-day opportunity stated in legal ground IV of RDR2026000865. The official receipt and all five submitted PDF fingerprints were verified; the package contains 40 pages.
items.purpose_es: El 23 de noviembre de 2026 se registró una aportación en el expediente de acceso R865/2026 tras la nueva oportunidad de diez días hábiles recogida en el fundamento jurídico IV de RDR2026000865. Se verificaron el justificante oficial y las huellas de los cinco PDF presentados; el conjunto contiene 40 páginas.

boundaries: The filing does not itself establish reopening, admission, incorporation, examination, disclosure or a merits decision.
The 5 October withdrawal/archive remains part of the chronology and is not erased by the later filing.

The public filing source key is opaque; the actual registration identifier, receipt verification code, personal identifiers, addresses, signatures, private locators and original filenames remain private.
Earlier dated preservation records remain historical provenance; this addendum does not certify universal completeness or global host parity.
